items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I remember Hemphill coming in the band. He was there in the band.

ctx.x: Man, wait a minute now. It could be at the same time. I don't know. Because I remember Hemphill coming in the band. He was there in the band. But no, I was there a little bit before him.
I see. Well, then, probably Gus Aikin might have been the trumpeter when you were there.
